provenance.upstream_config: examples/abp_pcap_detection/abp-pcap-xgb/config.pbtxt (sha256 e41ac015d614003ecb76853dd7224eb46ff9f314d4e3e5b99fe90ccf7a52fe20): Triton FIL backend, 13 FP32 inputs, model_type xgboost, output_class true, threshold 0.5
provenance.conversion: The upstream file is XGBoost's legacy binary format, which XGBoost 3 no longer reads. It was loaded with XGBoost 1.7.6 and saved with Booster.save_model as JSON; conversion_check.json holds 220 rows scored by 1.7.6 from the original file, and XGBoost 3.4.2 reproduces every margin and probability from the JSON exactly.

provenance.tokenizer_settings_from: models/model-information.csv at the same commit, the sid-minibert row: bert-base-uncased, max_length 256, stride 64, do_lower TRUE, do_truncate FALSE
provenance.vocabulary_from: models/data/bert-base-uncased-vocab.txt at the same commit (google bert-base-uncased)
provenance.gpu_hash_table: models/data/bert-base-uncased-hash.txt at the same commit: the vocabulary compiled for cuDF's GPU subword tokenizer, which upstream's PreprocessNLPStage read.
